name: Memento (Ranger 5 / Monster Hunter 1)
description: Memento the archer: homebrew Monster Hunter prestige class, DM-granted memories, items, trophies, Vaelor's Monsters' Manual.

abilities.name: Weapon Focus (longbow)
abilities.text: +1 on attack rolls with longbows.

abilities.name: Woodland Archer
abilities.text: Adjust for Range: after missing a foe with a ranged attack, +4 on later ranged attacks vs that foe this round (DM ruling: stacks per miss). Pierce the Foliage: after hitting despite concealment, next round your ranged attacks vs that foe ignore that concealment. Moving Sniper: after a successful sniping attack you may move once before re-hiding.

do.text: Pierce the Foliage: ignore this foe's concealment miss chance this round.
Moving Sniper: after a hit while sniping, take one move action before re-hiding.

abilities.name: Knowledge Devotion
abilities.text: Once per creature type per combat, make a Knowledge check (need 1+ rank in the matching Knowledge skill). Insight bonus on attack and damage vs that type: 15 or less +1, 16-25 +2, 26-30 +3, 31-35 +4, 36+ +5.

abilities.name: Distracting Attack
abilities.text: Whenever you hit an enemy with a weapon attack, that enemy is considered flanked by you until the end of your next turn.
abilities.todo: Confirm exact duration and whether the flank counts for you or only allies.

abilities.name: Memento Aqua
abilities.text: Memory fragment: +2 Swim; +2 attack and damage vs creatures whose habitat is mainly aquatic.

abilities.name: Memento Formido
abilities.text: Memory fragment: +2 Will vs any monster of your favored enemy or Monster Killer types.

abilities.name: The Shit I've Seen
abilities.text: +4 Survival.

abilities.name: Monster Killer
abilities.text: Chosen monster types (3 at MH1, 5 at MH5, 7 at MH8) usable for trophies, Monster Blow and Monster Horror. Monstrous Humanoid, Magical Beast and Outsider cost 2 picks; Dragon+Giant together cost 1.

abilities.name: Monster Blow
abilities.text: Declare before the attack roll. Target must be a Monster Killer type and below 50% HP. On hit: Fortitude save DC = damage dealt + MH level + Wis mod or die.

do.text: MONSTER BLOW: on hit, Fort DC = damage + classLevel(monster-hunter) + wisMod or die.

abilities.name: Trophy Crafting
abilities.text: Harvest ≤2 parts (more with Knowledge (Monsters) DC 10+MH) within 1 minute from Large+ monsters you damaged, Monster Killer types only. Max trophies = MH×2 + Wis mod; active slots 4 (MH1), 6 (MH4), 8 (MH7). Trophy bonuses ×2 at MH5, ×3 at MH10.

abilities.name: Imbue Trophy (Arms & Armor)
abilities.text: MH3: imbue trophies into magic weapons/armor/shields. 1 week, 1,000 gp per +1 equivalent, 50% failure destroys both.

abilities.name: Modify Trophy
abilities.text: MH4: change a trophy's slot once. Knowledge (Monsters) DC 15+MH, Craft (Taxidermy) DC 20, 500 gp and 500 XP × MH level.

abilities.name: Imbue Trophy (Wondrous Item)
abilities.text: MH6: imbue trophies into wondrous items. 25% failure; salvage trophy with Craft DC 30.

abilities.name: Monster Horror
abilities.text: MH10: immune to mind-affecting abilities of chosen types; +2 attack/damage/saves per matching trophy worn (min +2), enemies -2.

abilities.name: Monster Lore
abilities.text: MH2: Locate monster type DC 20, specific monster DC 30, assess below 50% HP DC 25 (+3 per size above Large).

abilities.name: Boots of Speed
abilities.text: Free action: spend one haste round (10 per day). This round: one extra attack on a full attack, +1 dodge to attack and AC, +1 Reflex, +30 ft speed. Choose again each round.

abilities.name: Ring of Swimming (cursed)
abilities.text: Cursed: cannot remove; must explore any new body of water (Will save).

abilities.name: Bracers of Archery, Lesser
abilities.text: +1 competence bonus on attack rolls with any bow (not crossbows); grants bow proficiency.

abilities.name: Belt of Strength +2
abilities.text: +2 enhancement bonus to Strength while worn.

abilities.name: Hand of Glory
abilities.text: Worn around the neck. Grants an extra ring slot (a ring worn on the hand works), Daylight 1/day and See Invisibility 1/day.

abilities.name: Daylight
abilities.text: CL 5: 60-ft radius bright light for 50 minutes.

abilities.name: See Invisibility
abilities.text: CL 5: see invisible creatures and objects for 50 minutes.

abilities.name: Pearl of the Sirines
abilities.text: Water breathing / freedom of movement underwater while held.

abilities.name: Monsters' Agony Whisper Whistle
abilities.text: 1/day: every Monstrous Humanoid, Magical Beast, Aberration and oversized (above Large) monster within 2 km cries out, revealing itself. Listen DC 15 for direction. They also learn your direction. Outsiders unaffected.

abilities.name: Strong-Arm Composite Longbow +1
abilities.text: Composite longbow with a +1 enhancement bonus. DM homebrew: adds your full Strength modifier to damage, up to +4 (no penalty for a low score). Two-handed. 1d8, ×3, 110 ft.

abilities.name: Studded Leather Armor
abilities.text: Light armor: +3 AC, max Dex +5, armor check penalty -1, 15% arcane spell failure.

abilities.name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds
abilities.text: CL 3: heals 2d8+3 hp. Standard action to drink; one potion is used up.

abilities.name: Potion of Cure Serious Wounds
abilities.text: CL 5: heals 3d8+5 hp. Standard action to drink; one potion is used up.

abilities.name: Vaelor's Monsters' Manual
abilities.text: Unique artifact, no slot, CL 12. Grants Monster Knowledge, Hunter's Analysis, Hunter's Instinct and the Bestiary Collection.

do.text: Hunter's Analysis: threat range doubled vs this target (if base is 19-20 use 17-20). If crit-immune: DR/SR -1 for 1 round, or suppress one ability (Knowledge DC 20).

abilities.name: Gargoyle's hands
abilities.text: Trophy crafting material (Monstrous humanoid). Crafts: Gargoyle bracers — DR 10/magic, freeze DC +15, +2 Con.

abilities.name: Gorgon's scale
abilities.text: Trophy crafting material (Magical beast). Crafts: Gorgon belt — +2d6 damage when charging, petrifying cone 60 ft 1/day DC +14 Fort negates.

abilities.name: Chuul Gloves (trophy)
abilities.text: Trophy: +4 initiative (improved initiative); paralysis touch DC 11+, Fort negates.

abilities.name: Gargoyle Bracers (trophy)
abilities.text: Trophy: DR 10/magic, freeze (appear as statue, Spot DC 15 + MH + Wis), +2 Con. Trophy bonuses are enhancement-type.

abilities.name: Rider Ring (drider trophy)
abilities.text: Trophy: SR 14, darkness at will.

abilities.name: Medusa Mask (trophy)
abilities.text: Trophy: petrifying gaze 1/day DC 12 Fort; 3 snake attacks 5 ft +3, 1d4 + poison 1d6 Str DC 12.

abilities.name: Shield Amulet (shield guardian trophy)
abilities.text: Trophy: +4 natural armor; stores one spell of each level 4/5/6.
